english.notes:
(i) The Criminal Justice Act 2003 section 288 and the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (Commencement No. 2 and Saving Provisions) Order 2004 (S.I. 2004 No. 81), provides that as from 22/01/2004 offences under section 5(1)(a), (ab), (aba), (ac), (ad), (ae), (af) and (c), and section 5(1A)(a) of the Firearms Act 1968 are triable only on indictment.
(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
